_comment: Real, working example for the Full Stack (Applied AI + DevOps) archetype. Use this one when the JD title is Software Engineer / Full Stack Engineer / Developer / Backend Engineer / AI Engineer with no SAP mention (see modes/_profile.md -> 'Which CV for which JD title'). For a SAP-titled JD, start from local/cv-payload-sap.example.json instead. Copy this file, rename it, drop this _comment key, then reorder/trim bullets for the target JD -- never add a claim that isn't already in cv-full-stack.md / cv.md.
name: Guna Sekhar
summary: Full Stack Engineer with approximately 2.3 years of experience building web applications and backend services with Node.js, React, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI -- across REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket APIs, SQL/NoSQL data stores, and async messaging -- plus hands-on Applied AI experience building MCP servers and agentic orchestration. Also owns the deployment side end-to-end: containerization, orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and cloud delivery.
competencies: REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket API design
MCP servers and agent tool APIs (Applied AI)

bullets: Built full-stack applications with Node.js and React: backend services (CRUD, business logic, validations) exposed via REST and GraphQL APIs, with WebSockets for real-time features.
Used PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis for data storage and caching, and Kafka/RabbitMQ/AWS SQS for asynchronous messaging between services.
Containerized services with Docker and orchestrated them with Kubernetes; provisioned cloud infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible/CloudFormation.
Set up CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions with automated testing gates, SonarQube code-quality checks, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
Built a FastAPI MCP server that translates natural-language requests from AI tools into structured calls to SAP Integration Suite iFlows and S/4HANA.
Engineered multiple MCP endpoints and consolidated them into a single FastMCP backend using dynamic tool registration, cutting cloud spend by approximately 70%.
Built the frontend and backend layers of an enterprise automation stack using Next.js, FastAPI, CrewAI orchestration, and OpenAI as the LLM provider.
Designed an MCP server connecting web-facing AI workflows to SAP BTP Integration Suite.
